## 1\. Entity Summary

revel8 (legal name revel8 GmbH, formerly Company Shield) is an AI-native security awareness and human risk management platform founded in Munich in 2024. It runs continuous, multi-channel attack simulations across email, SMS, WhatsApp, voice (vishing), messenger and deepfake video, adapted to each organisation's real attack surface using live threat intelligence and OSINT. The platform spans seven capability areas: the Awareness Playlist (orchestration), Threat Composer (AI simulation builder), Threat Intelligence & OSINT, Interactive Trainings, Risk Monitoring & Mitigation, Call Center Security (AI-agent red-teaming plus front-line vishing), and Integrations. It is fully automated and role-specific, helps enterprises quantify human risk, and meets NIS-2, DORA, ISO 27001 and BFSG requirements. It is hosted in Germany on STACKIT (Schwarz Group), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, GDPR compliant, and a member of the Allianz für Cyber-Sicherheit (BSI).

You Can’t Patch Your Way Out of This \| Mahdi Abdulrazak & Kim van Lavieren, Dawnguard \| Cyber Security District\\
\\
What if your infrastructure was built secure from minute one and stayed that way?\\
\\
In this special one year anniversary episode of Cyber Security District, host Jeroen Prinse sits back down with Mahdi Abdulrazak (CEO) and Kim van Lavieren (CTO) of Dawnguard, a security automation platform that turns approved security architecture directly into deployable cloud infrastructure as code.\\
\\
One year in, having just closed a pre-seed round and raised €6.3 million in total funding and opening a new office in New York, Dawnguard is making a bold bet: that the only real answer to modern cyber threats isn't better detection or faster patching, it's building systems that are resilient by design from the very start.\\
\\
Mahdi and Kim have both led security teams inside large organisations and lived through the same recurring nightmare: architecture locked in too early, security reviews arriving too late and a list of 50 findings that nobody has time to fix before the product ships. Dawnguard was built to break that cycle, with a collaborative canvas that lets teams design, validate and deploy secure infrastructure in minutes, with continuous drift detection to make sure it stays that way.\\
\\
One year on, we look back at how far that idea has come and what's next as the company expands.\\
\\
Key Takeaways:\\
\\*     You cannot patch your way out of agentic AI attacks, the only answer is building more resilient systems from the start\\
\\*     The hardest translation in security is from policy to architecture, ambiguity and contradictions there cascade into every layer below\\
\\*     Context is the missing ingredient in most security tooling: secure or insecure is a binary lens that doesn’t reflect reality\\
\\*     Drift detection only works when you know what was approved in the first place, that’s the advantage of integrating into the design lifecycle\\
\\*     Security decisions still belong to the business and engineers, Dawnguard removes the friction, not the ownership\\
\\*     The shift from protection to resilience is already happening: it’s not if you get breached, it’s how contained the blast radius is\\
\\*     European founders can compete, but capital conviction from investors matters as much as capital volume\\

# The benefits of multi-channel phishing attacks - An interview with our CEO Julius Muth

June 24, 2025

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67fd2c83be0cd4f397b3a2b2/681a3561a919b9bf83e4b878_Screenshot%202025-05-06%20at%2018.14.21.png)

### Introduction

In this interview, we talk with Julius Muth, Co-CEO of revel8, about the rising threat of multi-channel phishing attacks, how attackers exploit multiple communication platforms simultaneously, and what businesses can do to prepare their employees for the new wave of combined cyber attacks.

**Q: Julius, cybercriminals are becoming more sophisticated, leveraging multiple communication channels in their attacks. Can you explain why multi-channel phishing is such an effective tactic?**

Julius: Absolutely. Multi-channel phishing attacks exploit the fact that modern organizations rely on various communication tools - not only email but also SMS, phone calls, video conferencing, Teams, Whatsapp and more. Attackers take advantage of this by combining different channels to create highly convincing scams. For instance, an attacker might send a fraudulent email with a link to a faked website, follow up with a deepfake voice call, and even manipulate a video conference. This layered approach increases credibility and makes it harder for employees to detect deception.

**Q: What are some real-world examples where multi-channel phishing attacks have been successful?**

Julius: We’ve seen several high-profile cases recently. In 2024, ARUP lost $25 million due to a deepfake video call in which attackers impersonated the CFO. Another alarming case involved a helpdesk scam where attackers, posing as IT support, used a combination of phishing emails, phone calls, and fake chat support portals to trick employees into granting remote access to internal systems. By first sending an email alerting users of an "urgent IT issue," then following up with a phone call, and directing victims to a fraudulent web portal that mimicked the company’s real IT helpdesk, they successfully bypassed security measures and gained control over critical systems. These incidents show that cybercriminals are no longer relying on just email scams; they’re orchestrating complex, multi-faceted attacks that exploit human trust.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67fd2c83be0cd4f397b3a2b2/6839c620c7d5c432da28dfae_Bildschirmfoto%202025-05-30%20um%2016.47.39.png)

‍

**Q: How does revel8 help organizations defend against such sophisticated threats?**

Julius: At revel8, we recognize that traditional security awareness training isn’t enough. That’s why we’ve developed an AI-powered simulation platform that replicates real-world attacks across multiple channels. Our approach includes:

1. Live Threat Intelligence: We continuously update our training scenarios based on the latest real-world cyber threats.
2. OSINT Risk Profiling: We analyze publicly available information about an organization and its employees to simulate how attackers might target them.
3. AI-Powered Attack Simulations: We generate realistic phishing and social engineering scenarios in different combinations, using the same techniques hackers employ, including voice cloning and deepfake video.
4. Gamified Learning: Employees receive hyper-personalized training simulations tailored to their roles and risk levels, increasing engagement and retention.
5. Compliance & Reporting: Our reporting provides a live human risk assessment and further insights into current vulnerabilities.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67fd2c83be0cd4f397b3a2b2/6839c8c2a5956a878a12476f_Bildschirmfoto%202025-05-30%20um%2017.03.22.png)

**Q: How effective is this type of training?**

Julius: Incredibly effective. Our customers have seen a reduction in phishing click rates, an increase in attack reporting, and a boost in training completion rates. One of our clients even described our training as a "personal Spotify playlist of cyberattacks" (Dr. Peter Dornheim, Stihl AG) - each employee receives the most relevant simulations based on their unique risk profile and individual training performance.

**Q: Looking ahead, how do you see multi-channel phishing threats evolving, and how should businesses prepare?**

Julius: Attackers will continue to refine their methods, incorporating AI-generated content and automation to scale their scams. Businesses must move beyond outdated, generic security training and adopt dynamic, intelligence-driven simulations that evolve with the threat landscape. Organizations that fail to adapt risk falling victim to these increasingly sophisticated attacks. The best defense is a proactive one - constantly testing and strengthening the human firewall.

**Q: Thank you, Julius. Any final advice for companies looking to bolster their cybersecurity defenses?**

Julius: Yes - don’t wait until it’s too late. Cybersecurity isn’t just about technology; it’s about people. Train your employees using realistic, up-to-date simulations, and make security awareness an integral part of your company culture. If you’d like to see how revel8 can help, request a personal attack simulation today!‍

## Announcing Our Seed Round

Berlin-based cybersecurity startup revel8 closes seed round led by Peak to expand its human-centered cybersecurity platform. Founded by former Celonis employees, revel8 today counts FC Bayern, OBI and Stihl among its customers. The funding will be used to scale product development and empower more enterprise employees against AI-powered cyberattacks.

**Berlin, September 25, 2025** \- Berlin-based cybersecurity startup revel8, which trains employees with realistic attack simulations of the latest AI cyber threats, has raised a €5.7 million seed round. The round is led by Peak, with participation from Fortino Capital, Merantix Capital, and business angels including Mario Götze, Sergej Epp (CISO, Sysdig), Michael Schrank (CISO, Adidas), Rogier Fischer (Co-founder & CEO, Hadrian) and Alexander Rinke (CEO, Celonis).

Together with earlier pre-seed funding led by Merantix Capital, the company has now secured **€7 million in total since its founding in 2024**.

## **AI changes the cyber threat landscape**

Generative AI has made it easier for attackers to create convincing fake voices, images, and messages.

Vishing (voice phishing) incidents surged by more than 442% in 2024. That same year, a deepfake video call in Hong Kong convinced a bank manager at Arup to transfer $25 million. In April 2025, Marks & Spencer reported a voice phishing attack that caused losses of over £300 million.

Most breaches start with human error. _“Traditional e-learnings are out of date. Training users with realistic replicas of the latest, relevant scams proves to be much more effective_,” says co-founder and CEO Julius Muth. _“By continuously exposing users to cyberattacks across all communication channels, we help clients to build a strong security culture and reduce the risk of costly incidents.”_

## **How revel8 responds**

revel8 mimics the tactics of modern attackers.

Its AI-native, deepfake-first cyber platform **replicates new attack methods** in hours and, by leveraging open-source intelligence (OSINT), tailors simulations to each employee’s context.

Every individual receives a **personal ‘Spotify playlist of attacks’** that adapts dynamically to their role, behavior, and performance, strengthening defenses where it matters most. Through multi-channel realism and in-the-moment learning, the platform transforms the human factor from the weakest link into an active defense layer across the enterprise.

The company is among the **first cybersecurity providers on the Stackit marketplace** from Schwarz Group, offering enterprises a European cloud option.

_“Generative AI is transforming the threat landscape faster than enterprises can react. revel8’s AI native approach replicates real-world attacks in hours, not months, and turns the human factor into an active defense layer. We believe this team has the vision and execution power to build Europe’s category leader in AI-native cyber security for human risk. That’s why we’re proud to back revel8 and support them on their Go-To-Market to scale internationally”,_ says Johan van Mil, Co-founder & Managing Partner **at Peak.**

_"I know firsthand how powerful revel8's product is. They created a deepfake of my voice to try to fool our team into filling fake invoices,"_ said Rasmus Rothe, Co-founder and General Partner at **Merantix Capital**. _‍_

_"Since the very beginning, we've been astonished with revel8's speed, execution, and early traction. I'm thankful they are on the good side, and I have no doubt revel8 will be the category-leading AI cybersecurity giant that Europe desperately needs."_

## **From founding idea to vision**

Julius Muth, Tom Müller, and Robert Seilbeck founded revel8 after seeing how unprepared organizations were for AI-based impersonation.Their goal is to **train** **10 million ‘human firewalls.’**

With the new funding, revel8 expands its team, strengthens enterprise features, and grows internationally.

_“We want to make sure that companies are not left behind in the arms race between attackers and defenders,”_ says Muth. _“This investment gives us the resources to build the next generation of defense tools for the next generation of threats.”_

# Berlin-based data security firm revel8 secures €5.7M led by Peak

Berlin-based Revel8, which trains employees to defend against AI-driven cyberattacks, [has raised](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/merantix-capital_revel8-has-raised-a-57-million-seed-round-activity-7376876453998788609-Swkt?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAADLXLE4BNNDbYnXXeV2wh_DxAc1SssTOf5c) a €5.7 million seed round led by Peak, bringing its total funding to €7 million.

- Launched in 2023 by Julius Muth, Tom Müller, and Robert Seilbeck, [Revel8](https://www.revel8.ai/) develops cybersecurity software aimed at tackling AI-driven social engineering.
- The company concentrates on strengthening the human layer of defense through adaptive simulations delivered across multiple communication channels, including email, SMS, voice, and video.
- The platform functions as an AI-native training environment that draws on live threat intelligence and open-source intelligence (OSINT) to generate individual risk profiles. These insights are used to design personalized attack scenarios that adapt to each employee’s role, behavior, and performance.
-  By replicating the methods attackers actively use, ranging from phishing and vishing to deepfake impersonation, the system exposes users to realistic threats and reinforces decision-making under pressure.

#### **Details of the deal**

- The funding round was led by [Peak](https://peak.capital/), with additional participation from [Fortino Capital](https://www.bing.com/search?q=Fortino+Capital&gs_lcrp=EgRlZGdlKgYIABBFGDkyBggAEEUYOagCALACAA&FORM=ANCMS9&PC=DCTS), [Merantix Capital,](https://www.merantix-capital.com/about#:~:text=Merantix%20Capital%20is%20a%20Berlin-based%20venture%20capital%20firm,foster%20interactions%20between%20ideas%2C%20talent%2C%20industry%2C%20and%20policy.) and angel investors Mario Götze, Sergej Epp, Michael Schrank, Rogier Fischer, and Alexander Rinke.

> _"We are proud to participate again in this round of funding to support revel8’s mission to better fight cyberattacks in the age of AI," Merantix Capital's team,_ [_commented_](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/merantix-capital_revel8-has-raised-a-57-million-seed-round-activity-7376876453998788609-Swkt?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAADLXLE4BNNDbYnXXeV2wh_DxAc1SssTOf5c) _on LinkedIn._

- Revel8 plans to use the new funding to fuel its next stage of growth by expanding its team, strengthening enterprise-grade features, and pushing forward with international expansion.
- The investment will enable the company to further develop its AI-native platform, refine adaptive training capabilities, and broaden its reach to organizations worldwide.

## Our mission

We're on a mission to create 10 million human firewalls! At revel8, we redefine cybersecurity training with hyper-realistic simulations that reflect today's evolving attack landscape. Our innovative platform combines AI-driven multi-channel attacks with gamified, real-time learning to build resilience where it matters most: the people.

## Your mission

We're shifting our go-to-market to partner-first. Today, our reseller and partner business is built and run by one person, already generating our first partner-led revenue. As Head of Channel & Partnerships, you take full ownership of this function and build it into a state-of-the-art partner program spanning resellers, MSSPs, system integrators, and technology partners — rooted in DACH today, expanding across Europe and the US tomorrow. Success looks like a partner landscape that scales revenue well beyond what one person can carry alone: systematic, repeatable, and built for the long run.

How your day-to-day will look like:

- **Build the Partner Program:** You design and stand up a systematic, scalable channel and partnerships program — from partner strategy and tiering to onboarding and enablement — taking what's been built by one person so far to a state-of-the-art level.

- **Grow & Manage the Partner Landscape:** You identify, recruit, and manage resellers, MSSPs, system integrators, and technology partners, expanding our footprint from DACH into Europe and the US.

- **Enable & Coach Partners:** You translate revel8's strategy into concrete partner activities, check in on their progress, share what's working across the portfolio, and keep partners accountable and on track.

- **Own Partner Relationships:** You run regular partner visits and partner days, building the kind of trust and closeness that turns a signed partner into an active, revenue-generating one.

- **Drive Partner Communications & Events:** You set up the cadence, channels, and events that keep partners informed, engaged, and selling — from updates and enablement sessions to conferences and partner summits.

- **Create Partner Content, Cross-Functionally:** You work closely with sales and marketing to produce the content, collateral, and campaigns partners need to position and sell revel8 effectively.

- **Report & Represent:** You track partner-led pipeline and revenue, give the founders a clear read on what's working, and represent revel8's partner program externally as the face of the function.


## Is it you we are looking for?

You...

- bring **several years of experience building or scaling channel and partnerships programs**, ideally in cybersecurity or B2B SaaS.
- have a **background in security awareness, GRC, or an adjacent cybersecurity category**: You understand the challenges our customers face and speak our partners' language from day one.
- have a **strong, referenceable reputation in the cybersecurity channel:** Partners, resellers, and MSSPs know your name, and people are happy to vouch for you.
- have **already owned this topic independently:** You did not just contributed operationally to someone else's program, but built and run one yourself end to end.
- think in **partner and ecosystem economics:** You understand how distributors and partners create value, what makes them prioritize revel8 over competing vendors, and how partner-led services revenue turns distribution into a strategic capability — not just a sales route.
- bring **solid sales and discovery skills yourself:** You understand prospecting, discovery, and deal management well enough to coach and support partners through their own deals, not just manage them from the sidelines.
- have **sharp commercial judgment:** You know which opportunities deserve investment and when to walk away from low-probability deals.
- are a **builder at heart:** You're energized by turning a one-person, early-stage function into a structured, scalable program, and you thrive with real ownership in an fast-paced environment.
- are **comfortable traveling regularly** for partner visits, partner days, and events across Europe.
- are **fluent in English (business proficient)**

Bonus:

- Existing network of resellers, MSSPs, or system integrators in DACH, Europe, or the US.
- Experience building a channel or partner program from scratch at a seed- or early-stage startup.
- Additional European languages, opening the door to further markets.
